reconfigure_resources.description:
Select related cleaning-system devices, such as a separately represented dock/station. Vacuum Schedule automatically discovers their enabled entities.

For future pre-flight checks, explicitly bind the clean-water and dirty-water tank status sources. If the selected dock exposes obvious `clean water` / `dirty water` entities, Vacuum Schedule will try to auto-detect them after submission.

The individual-entity field remains a fallback for unusual Home Assistant registry layouts.
reconfigure_resources.title: Related devices

data_description.cleaning_mode: What the robot should do: vacuum only, mop only, or combine both. “Do not override” leaves this setting unchanged at start.
data_description.cleaning_route: How the robot plans its cleaning path. Shown only when the device exposes such a control.
data_description.dates: Optional comma-separated local dates in YYYY-MM-DD format.
data_description.execution_window_minutes: deadline_at is this long after planned_start, but never later than the next occurrence of the same schedule.
data_description.fan_mode: Suction power. “Do not override” leaves the vacuum’s current/default power unchanged at start.
data_description.minimum_battery_percent: Optional. Blank = use the global value from Schedule execution.
data_description.minimum_start_window_minutes: Optional. Blank = global value. Remaining time is measured to the nearest job deadline or enabled DND start.
data_description.mop_mode: Floor-mopping algorithm such as standard, deep, or fast when supported by the robot.
data_description.passes: How many times the robot should cover the selected cleaning zones.
data_description.water_mode: Water flow to the mop. This is separate from clean/dirty dock tank status.
data_description.weekdays: Select recurring weekdays. You may combine them with specific dates.
data_description.zone_execution_policy: Single robot run waits for all selected cleaning zones and starts them together. As zones become ready may execute ready zones earlier and clean the remaining zones later.

cancel_job.description: Cancels the selected active Job. In Real mode, an active physical execution is stopped through the execution backend; in Dry-Run, only the simulated execution attempt is cancelled.
cancel_job.name: Cancel job

emit_test_event.description: Emits vacuum_schedule_test_event to verify Vacuum Schedule action and event registration.
emit_test_event.name: Emit test event

recheck_job.description: Immediately re-evaluates the current Job pre-flight state without resetting occupancy/access stabilization timers.
recheck_job.name: Recheck job

refresh_capabilities.description: Rebuilds the read-only capability snapshot for a loaded Vacuum Schedule entry and emits vacuum_schedule_capabilities_refreshed. No robot command is sent.

config_entry_id.description: Vacuum Schedule config entry to refresh.
config_entry_id.name: Config entry

refresh_capabilities.name: Refresh capabilities

run_schedule_now.description: Backward-compatible alias of Additional run: uses the current local day profile and does not consume the scheduled occurrence.
run_schedule_now.name: Additional run (legacy action name)

set_execution_gate.description: Changes the global execution gate for the selected Vacuum Schedule entry.

disabled_until.description: Required only for the disabled-until mode.

execution_gate.description: Enabled, disabled, or disabled until a date/time.

set_execution_gate.name: Set execution gate

set_schedule_enabled.description: Enables or disables one Vacuum Schedule schedule.
set_schedule_enabled.name: Set schedule enabled

skip_job.description: Finishes a planned or waiting Job as a user-initiated failure. No physical robot command is sent.
skip_job.name: Skip job

start_job_now.description: Backward-compatible low-level action by Job ID. Releases an existing PLANNED/WAIT Job; schedule automations should normally use Run early manually or Smart run.

ignore_busy_zones.name: Ignore occupied zones
ignore_busy_zones.description: Accept only current zone_busy blockers for this one start. All other authoritative pre-flight blockers remain in force.

start_job_now.name: Start job now

additional_run.name: Additional run
additional_run.description: Creates a separate manual Job from the selected schedule using the cleaning profile effective for the current Home Assistant local calendar day. It does not consume the scheduled occurrence.

schedule_id.name: Schedule ID
schedule_id.description: Stable Vacuum Schedule schedule identifier. The same ID is shown in the Schedules table.

run_early.name: Run early manually
run_early.description: Executes the nearest future materialized occurrence of the selected schedule now. The Job keeps the cleaning-parameter snapshot of its original planned day and the occurrence is consumed as an early execution.

schedule_id.name: Schedule ID
schedule_id.description: Stable Vacuum Schedule schedule identifier. The same ID is shown in the Schedules table.

ignore_busy_zones.name: Ignore occupied zones
ignore_busy_zones.description: Accept only current zone_busy blockers for this one start. All other authoritative pre-flight blockers remain in force.

smart_run.name: Smart run
smart_run.description: Automation-oriented start. If a not-yet-started scheduled occurrence for the current local day still exists, executes that exact occurrence; otherwise creates a separate additional run using today's effective profile.

schedule_id.name: Schedule ID
schedule_id.description: Stable Vacuum Schedule schedule identifier. The same ID is shown in the Schedules table.

ignore_busy_zones.description: Accept only current zone_busy blockers for this one start. All other authoritative pre-flight blockers remain in force.

pause_job.name: Pause current execution
pause_job.description: Pauses the selected scheduler-owned REAL execution. The Job remains active and can be resumed.

resume_job.name: Resume current execution
resume_job.description: Resumes the selected scheduler-owned REAL execution when the robot is observed paused.

set_schedule_paused.name: Pause or resume schedule
set_schedule_paused.description: Changes the schedule execution pause without disabling calendar planning. A paused schedule keeps its projection but does not start Jobs.

schedule_id.name: Schedule ID
schedule_id.description: Stable Vacuum Schedule schedule identifier. The same ID is shown in the Schedules table.

paused.name: Paused
paused.description: Whether execution of this schedule is paused.

rebuild_schedule.description: Rebuilds future materialized Jobs from the current schedule definitions. Can optionally restore occurrences that were previously consumed by early execution.

restore_early_executed.name: Restore early-executed occurrences
restore_early_executed.description: Also recreate future occurrences that had already been consumed by early execution.
